assumptions: The slit openings are narrow and identical.

resetPath.description: Repeat the observation after aligning the screen.

layers.observation: The notebook has fewer than two recorded observations.
layers.plainLanguage: Record another observation so you can compare what changed.
layers.technicalDetail: Use a different bounded apparatus setting and preserve its recorded controls and result.

consultationRules.nextStep: Record a second observation in the measurement notebook.

layers.observation: The Young lecture record has not been inspected.
layers.plainLanguage: Inspect the lecture record before using it as evidence.
layers.technicalDetail: Compare the source’s provenance and case relationship with your recorded observations.

consultationRules.nextStep: Inspect Thomas Young’s 1801 lecture record in the Curated Record.

layers.observation: The recorded observations use the same screen-distance setting.
layers.plainLanguage: Try a different screen distance to make the comparison more informative.
layers.technicalDetail: Keep the observation record intact while changing only a bounded primary control.

consultationRules.nextStep: Adjust screen distance and record an additional observation.

layers.observation: No limitation or alternative explanation is recorded with the draft.
layers.plainLanguage: State what the available evidence does not settle.
layers.technicalDetail: A limitation distinguishes the observed record from a claim that goes beyond it.

consultationRules.nextStep: Add a limitation or alternative explanation to the Theory Board.

peerReviewRules.feedback: The draft needs more selected, inspected evidence before it can be reviewed as a bounded claim.
peerReviewRules.revisionPath: Return to the Theory Board and select the missing evidence.

peerReviewRules.feedback: One or more selected support references are no longer available in the current evidence record.
peerReviewRules.revisionPath: Return to the Theory Board and replace unavailable support with current evidence.

peerReviewRules.feedback: The draft uses language that may reach beyond the recorded evidence. Consider a more bounded statement.
peerReviewRules.revisionPath: Return to the Theory Board and qualify the claim using the available evidence and limitation.

debrief.summary: Compare the observed pattern with the available evidence before drawing a conclusion.
